# QGC UI review

## Checks

- [ ] Vehicle/group/all scope is explicit.
- [ ] Selected count and system IDs remain visible.
- [ ] Focused, disabled, busy, stale, offline, timeout, and partial states exist.
- [ ] Color is not the only carrier of meaning.
- [ ] Critical gestures have visible alternatives.
- [ ] Dangerous actions show frozen targets and require confirmation.
- [ ] Sent, acknowledged, executing, and completed are distinguishable.
- [ ] QML contains no blocking work or complex domain logic.
- [ ] Existing QGC controls and palette are reused.
- [ ] Layout works at 1920x1080 and 1366x768.
- [ ] Chinese/English labels, units, and keyboard focus are tested.
